id="u133"><button class="w-tabs-section-header active" aria-controls="content-u133" aria-expanded="true"><div class="w-tabs-section-title">About</div><div class="w-tabs-section-control"></div></button><div  class="w-tabs-section-content" id="content-u133"><div class="w-tabs-section-content-h i-cf"><div class="wpb_text_column us_custom_0d9421fe has_text_color"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><p>Unveiling Western Australia&#8217;s Hidden Kitesurfing Gems</p>
</div></div><div class="wpb_text_column us_custom_4011495b"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><p><strong>Zephyr Tours has built its reputation on the relentless pursuit of unmatched kitesurfing destinations. We ensure our clients receive nothing short of exceptional service and exclusive access to the best kite spots in Australia and abroad. Our brand-new tour to Western Australia highlights this commitment, promising an extraordinary experience like no other.</strong></p>
<p>Get ready to redefine your notions of remote kitesurfing because Zephyr Tours is about to revolutionise the experience! Picture yourself on a stunningly beautiful beach, with 25 knots of wind whipping around you, as you glide across crystal-clear turquoise waters teeming with marine life beneath your board. Now, take that image and transport yourself to a secluded beach with only you, your mates, and the Zephyr Crew &#8211; providing unparalleled service, daily coaching, and, of course, a delicious and nutritious lunch in our fully customised mobile kite centre.</p>
</div></div><div class="wpb_text_column us_custom_e8864348"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><p>NO NEED TO SACRIFICE ON COMFORT!</p>
</div></div><div class="wpb_text_column"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><p>Imagine stepping into this piece of paradise, complete with a well-equipped kitchen and a fridge to keep your beverages cold, offering shade from the sun and shelter from the wind so you can savour your meal without any unwanted crunchiness. After a thrilling day of kitesurfing in the most pristine spots, indulge in a hot shower to wash away the salt and sand, preparing for a comfortable journey back to your accommodation. With Zephyr Tours, every aspect of your remote kitesurfing adventure is redefined for ultimate comfort and enjoyment.</p>
<p>This exclusive tour offers unparalleled access to remote kitesurfing spots hidden within the breathtaking landscapes of Cape Range National Park. Limited to a small group of only seven clients, this intimate experience promises unforgettable highs and boosted stoke amidst the pristine beauty of Western Australia&#8217;s coastline.</p>
</div></div></div></div></div><div class="w-tabs-section" id="pab3"><button class="w-tabs-section-header" aria-controls="content-pab3" aria-expanded="false"><div class="w-tabs-section-title">Inclusions</div><div class="w-tabs-section-control"></div></button><div  class="w-tabs-section-content" id="content-pab3"><div class="w-tabs-section-content-h i-cf"><div class="wpb_text_column us_custom_4e770d61 has_text_color"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><p>Remote Kitesurfing Redefined</p>
</div></div><div class="wpb_text_column us_custom_4011495b"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><p><span style="font-family: 'Calibri',sans-serif;"><strong>With our reliable new Toyota Landcruiser Prado and our innovative custom-made mobile kite centre (wait ‘til you see this!), Zephyr is ready to whisk you away to some of Western Australia&#8217;s most exceptional and secluded kitesurfing destinations. </strong></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 'Calibri',sans-serif;">Experience seamless transportation and enjoy top-notch facilities, knowing that every detail has been meticulously arranged.</span></p>
</div></div><div class="wpb_text_column us_custom_b202f6b0"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><p>OUR WA REMOTE KITEBOARDING TOUR INCLUDES:</p>

</div></div><div class="wpb_text_column"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><p><strong>Based out of Exmouth, Western Australia, each day on tour, Zephyr will take you off the beaten track to remote kitesurfing spots along the rugged W.A. coastline, offering access to the pristine waters within the Cape Range National Park. </strong></p>
<p>Surrounded by stunning natural beauty, you will explore the rich marine ecosystems while enjoying kitesurfing against the backdrop of breathtaking landscapes.</p>
<p>To reach Exmouth, you&#8217;ll need to catch a flight from Perth, Australia. <a href="https://www.qantas.com/au/en.html">Qantas</a> is the only carrier offering flights from Perth to Exmouth, with daily operations ensuring convenient access to this unmatched destination.</p>
<p>On arrival day, you&#8217;ll receive a warm welcome from the familiar Zephyr Team at Exmouth Airport. From there, it&#8217;s straight to your Exmouth accommodation to relax poolside with a cocktail in hand. But don&#8217;t get too comfortable just yet—as the following day, we&#8217;ll dive straight into your first exhilarating kitesurfing session.</p>
<p>While our itinerary may be dictated by the wind, we can guarantee a fresh and exciting adventure each day on tour.</p>
</div></div></div></div></div><div class="w-tabs-section" id="rbd8"><button class="w-tabs-section-header" aria-controls="content-rbd8" aria-expanded="false"><div class="w-tabs-section-title">Accommodation</div><div class="w-tabs-section-control"></div></button><div  class="w-tabs-section-content" id="content-rbd8"><div class="w-tabs-section-content-h i-cf"><div class="wpb_text_column us_custom_0d9421fe has_text_color"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><p>Exmouth Escape Resort: a luxurious haven in the heart of Exmouth.</p>
</div></div><div class="wpb_text_column us_custom_92b2762d"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><p>The <a href="https://exmouthescaperesort.com.au/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Escape Resort</a> in Exmouth offers 4.5-star accommodation. Its great location provides a luxurious base for guests, offering a relaxing retreat after a full day of kitesurfing and adventures. With modern amenities and alfresco dining, guests can unwind and rejuvenate in style amidst the beauty of Western Australia&#8217;s coastline.</p>
<p>We have reserved spacious 2-bedroom apartments for our guests, with each bedroom featuring its own ensuite bathroom. We think there&#8217;s no need for a single supplement. However, if you would prefer to have a whole one-bedroom apartment to yourself, please contact us for pricing and availability.</p>
